Timeline

[edit]
  • 2015
  • 2016
  • Show All
  • September 15th - Popular betting site, CSGOLounge.com, create their own CS:GO division by signing the roster of Dobry&Gaming. [1]
  • November 25th - Lounge Gaming sign mouz and move Loord to coach. [2]
  • January 27th - Lounge Gaming part ways with oskarish and add MINISE as a stand-in. [3]
  • February 21st - Lounge Gaming sign MINISE. [4]
  • May 15th - Lounge Gaming part ways with their roster. [5]
